title: Contract Violation Finder
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: xAPI
Learning Analytics
Producer Contract
Activity IRI
Data Quality
description: A p5.js critique exercise in which learners audit eight candidate xAPI statements, flag the fields that break the MicroSim producer contract and justify each flag by section number, with feedback that marks each flag correct, missed or false alarm.
audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners (college undergraduate and professional development)

educational.topic: Auditing xAPI statements against the MicroSim producer contract
learningObjectives: The learner will critique a candidate xAPI statement against the producer contract's rules and justify each violation by section number.
prerequisites: The five parts of an xAPI statement and the three MicroSim verbs (Chapter 16)
Activity IRIs, canonical site URL and fragments (Chapter 16)

accessibility.notes: Row and Rule dropdowns with a Flag row with rule button replace clicking; keys 1-9 toggle rules; results use words (correct, missed, false alarm) as well as color

controls.label: Producer contract rules 1-9
controls.purpose: Link the selected flag to a rule

controls.label: Check my answer
controls.purpose: Reveal planted violations and grade each flag

controls.label: Show hint
controls.purpose: Highlight the statement section that still hides a violation

controls.label: Next statement
controls.purpose: Advance to the next candidate statement

controls.label: Clear flags
controls.purpose: Remove all flags on the current statement

controls.label: Flag row with rule
controls.purpose: Keyboard alternative to clicking a row and a rule

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Error detection with justification against a checklist, with graded feedback
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Flag-and-justify critique over a set of worked examples
keyQuestions: Does this identifier start with the canonical site URL and end with a trailing slash?
Does the verb carry the result field it requires?
Would this fragment survive a reshuffle or a reorder?
commonMisconceptions: Any IRI that loads in the browser is a valid activity IRI
A slider can be typed as the MicroSim it lives in
Every statement in an audit must contain an error
assessmentOpportunities: Violations found with the correct section number
Stating the downstream consequence of a violation
